title: Unreliable internet at a rural learning centre
summary: A community learning centre for after-school students loses connectivity for hours most weekdays, interrupting scheduled digital literacy sessions.
affected_group: Students aged 10-16 attending after-school digital literacy classes
current_workaround: Staff reschedule sessions manually and rely on printed worksheets when the connection drops
relevant_organization: Prefers a university or NGO partner; not yet contacted

title: Low awareness of early symptoms of anaemia among adolescent girls
summary: A neighbourhood health worker reports that adolescent girls often do not recognise early symptoms of anaemia and delay seeking care.
affected_group: Adolescent girls aged 12-18 in a low-income urban neighbourhood
current_workaround: Occasional word-of-mouth advice from the health worker during home visits

title: Public library website not usable with screen readers
summary: A city public library's website cannot be navigated with common screen-reader software, blocking catalogue search and account access for visually impaired patrons.
affected_group: Visually impaired library patrons who rely on assistive technology
current_workaround: Patrons call the library desk by phone to search the catalogue on their behalf
relevant_organization: City public library (contact not yet established)

title: No structured way for young tailors to find paid stitching work
summary: Newly trained tailors from a vocational program struggle to find consistent paying work after completing their course.
affected_group: Recently trained tailors, mostly women, aged 18-30
current_workaround: Word-of-mouth referrals through the vocational trainer's personal contacts

title: Volunteer meal deliveries are double-booked or missed
summary: Volunteers delivering meals to elderly residents frequently double up on the same household while other households are missed entirely.
affected_group: Homebound elderly residents relying on volunteer-delivered meals
current_workaround: A shared spreadsheet updated manually and inconsistently by different volunteers

title: Small nonprofit lacks a way to track donor communication
summary: A small nonprofit currently tracks donor conversations across personal email inboxes, causing missed follow-ups and duplicated outreach.
affected_group: Nonprofit staff and the donors they communicate with
current_workaround: Personal email folders and a shared paper notebook
relevant_organization: Small nonprofit organisation (name withheld pending contact)

title: Plastic waste accumulating along a seasonal riverbank
summary: Residents near a seasonal riverbank report increasing plastic waste accumulation after each monsoon, with no regular cleanup or segregation process.
affected_group: Residents of villages along the riverbank and downstream water users
current_workaround: Occasional informal cleanup drives organised by residents

title: Adult literacy learners drop out due to inflexible class timings
summary: An adult literacy program run by a community centre sees high dropout because fixed evening class timings conflict with learners' work shifts.
affected_group: Working adults enrolled in an evening literacy program
current_workaround: Instructors informally repeat lessons one-on-one for learners who miss class

title: No easy way for first-time farmers to access soil-testing guidance
summary: First-generation farmers in a peri-urban belt lack accessible guidance on when and how to get soil tested before planting.
affected_group: First-generation and smallholder farmers in a peri-urban area
current_workaround: Occasional advice sought informally from more experienced neighbouring farmers
relevant_organization: Local farmers' collective (informal, not yet a registered entity)

title: Job-seekers with disabilities struggle to find accessible listings
summary: Job-seekers with mobility or sensory disabilities report that most local job listings do not mention accessibility of the workplace or role.
affected_group: Job-seekers with mobility or sensory disabilities
current_workaround: Manually calling employers individually to ask about accessibility before applying
